operation.summary: One issue with its status history, team note and what you can send back; agents in Fixer Mode also get images, context and the attached log (and their first read marks a new issue seen)

query.name: size
query.description: Preset: agent (1568 px, q85), thumb (512, q75), large (2560, q90), original

query.name: max_edge_px
query.description: Long edge limit, 64-20000; overrides the preset

operation.returns: issue: ref (team number, e.g. M0042, or null until sent), description, status, team_note, history[at, kind, status, by, note], followup_outcomes; Fixer Mode: context, images[data_base64], log[], allowed_next

max_edge_px.description: Long edge limit, 64-20000; overrides the preset
